newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Copene upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Copene upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Banco Fator said it has upgraded its recommendation on Brazilian petrochemical firm Copene to buy from hold but has maintained its hold and sell recommendations on Copesul and Unipar.
-- Fator analyst Juan Tseng cited an expected improvement in prices for basic petrochemicals, which it said was likely to mostly benefit Copene.

-- "A turnaround in the sector appears to be emerging as the price of naphtha has been falling in the past few months ... (while) basic petrochemical prices are maintaining their vigor," Tseng wrote in a report.
-- He said Fator expects the "valuation discount of the Brazilian (petrochemical) sector relative to the international sector to narrow."
-- He attributed the firming trend in basic petrochemicals prices to stronger global demand, stable production capacity through 1997 and China's re-entry into the market in mid-1996.
"Future contracts for oil point to protracted pricing decline," he said, adding tensions between Iraq and the United States and China's potential re-exit from the market are other risks.

-- Tseng also said domestic basic petrochemical producers plan to expand capacity starting in 1998 in response to increased demand as petrochemical consumption is expected to rise by 10 percent a year for the next two or three years.
